title: Daily electricity use of an office building
intro: A facilities engineer recorded 15 weekdays in an office building: the daily electricity use (kWh), the mean outdoor temperature (°C), the number of people badged in (Occupancy) and the hours of sunshine. The model has k = 3 predictors and so p = 4 coefficients: Energy = b₀ + b₁·Outdoor temp + b₂·Occupancy + b₃·Sunshine. With n = 15 days, the error degrees of freedom are n − k − 1 = 11.
